title: Vue3: Update renderer's setup function to allow passing generic HostElement type

## Greptile Summary

Added generic type parameter support for host element types in Vue 3 renderer's setup function, improving type safety for framework integrations like Nuxt.js.

- Added `AppHostElement` generic type parameter to Vue 3 renderer setup function in `code/renderers/vue3/src/render.ts`
- Eliminates need for manual type casting when specifying custom host element types
- Maintains existing functionality while enhancing type safety
- Compatible with Vue 3's typing system and Storybook's component model
